title: Context for every text in AI translation
summary: Per-text context in AI translation, Quick Create chat groups, one shared voice library, two-line subtitles and Canva sign-in.

sections.title: Translation quality
sections.note: AI translation uses more of what you already know.

items.body: Each text can carry its own context, such as an i18n key
The model sees approved memory wording for phrases inside each text
Long documents keep the same wording throughout
Terms now match in Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Thai
One voice library across Playground and Translate Video
Subtitles on two lines of 42 characters
Split view scrolls both languages together
Quick Create: chat groups with shared rules
Canva: sign in with your email and stay connected
One language order in every picker
QE reports cost 4 credits per source word
Audio-only exports with lip-synced cards work on retry
480p and 360p exports have no black bars
Adding a language no longer overwrites earlier ones
